title: Second Largest
hints: Keep two variables: largest and second. Start both at Integer.MIN_VALUE.
When a number is bigger than largest, the old largest becomes second. When it is between them (and different from largest), it becomes second.
Use a boolean (or a counter) to know whether a second value was ever found, so that 5 5 5 prints No second largest.

pt-br.title: Segundo maior
hints: Guarde duas variáveis: largest e second. Comece as duas com Integer.MIN_VALUE.
Quando um número for maior que largest, o antigo largest vira second. Quando ficar entre os dois (e diferente de largest), ele vira second.
Use um boolean (ou um contador) para saber se algum segundo valor foi encontrado, assim 5 5 5 imprime No second largest.
mustContain: Guarde os números em um array.
mustNotContain: Resolva com laços sobre o array, sem ordenar nem usar streams.

mustContain.message: Store the numbers in an array.

mustNotContain.message: Solve it with loops over the array, without sorting or streams.
